metadata.description: Comprehensive reasoning test prompts for AI evaluation

prompts.text: If all cats are animals, and some animals are pets, can we conclude that some cats are pets? Explain your reasoning.

A train leaves Station A at 10 AM traveling at 60 mph. Another train leaves Station B at 11 AM traveling at 80 mph toward Station A. If the stations are 200 miles apart, at what time will the trains meet?

A company's sales increased by 30% after launching a new marketing campaign. However, at the same time, their main competitor went out of business. What can we conclude about the effectiveness of the marketing campaign?
A self-driving car must choose between swerving into a wall (injuring its passenger) or continuing straight (hitting a pedestrian). What factors should inform this decision?
Explain the process of photosynthesis in simple terms that a 10-year-old could understand.
Design a system to help elderly people who live alone stay connected with their families without requiring technical knowledge.
A friend tells you they just lost their job and are feeling devastated. How would you respond?
You notice that website traffic increases every Tuesday but conversions remain flat. What hypotheses might explain this pattern, and how would you test them?
